source_batch.unit_label: BRBL::MOD_D::U10: Distinguish at-will,particular and fixed-term partnerships from an LLP

payload.title: Identify the duration and the legal form
payload.core_explanation_md:
A partnership at will has neither an agreed duration nor a provision determining its termination in the described statutory sense. A partnership for a particular undertaking and one for a fixed period require attention to that agreed purpose or period. Continuing business after an expired term can engage the described at-will/default-continuity rules; do not assume the original expiry date still explains every later transaction.

An LLP is a different statutory vehicle: incorporation gives it a separate legal personality and continuing existence. Its partner-agency structure should not be replaced by the ordinary firm rule. Check the incorporation record and governing agreement before describing all arrangements called partnerships as identical.

self_check.prompt_text: What should be checked before treating a firm as at will?
self_check.expected_takeaway: The agreement for duration and determination, not merely its title.

payload.stem_md: The agreement fixes a single construction undertaking and contains termination terms. A file calls it at will only because no calendar end date appears. What matters?

options.text_md: The undertaking and determination provisions in the agreement
options.explanation_md: An absence of a calendar date alone is not conclusive.
A label cannot replace the agreement.

options.text_md: The amount of the first deposit
options.explanation_md: Deposit size does not determine duration.

options.text_md: Whether the business uses online banking

payload.correct_explanation_md: An absence of a calendar date alone is not conclusive.

payload.stem_md: A registered LLP continues despite a partner change. Why should ordinary-firm assumptions be avoided?

options.explanation_md: The separate entity can act under its law.

options.text_md: Every partner change must destroy every entity
The LLP has a distinct incorporated identity and statutory agency rules
LLP registration removes every wrongdoing liability
options.explanation_md: Separate personality does not provide that unlimited protection.
